import os,subprocess,json,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
src=p.parent/'rain-two-sweep-experiment'
for arm in ['candidate']:
 out=p/arm;out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
 env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('GPU_PHYSICS_','WGPU_','RAIN_'))}
 env.update(RAIN_CELL_ROW='3',RAIN_CELL_COLUMN='9',RAIN_REPLAY_BASE='3907',RAIN_REPLAY_STATE=str(src/'hip-initial.txt'),RAIN_REPLAY_LIMITS='1',RAIN_REPLAY_HEALTH='1',RAIN_REPLAY_COLLISIONS='1',GPU_PHYSICS_LIVE_CONTACT_ORDER='0',WGPU_BACKEND='vulkan',GPU_PHYSICS_STATE_TRACE=str(out/'trace.jsonl'))
 cmd=[str(src/f'{arm}-ordinary/fixture'),'600'];start=time.monotonic()
 with (out/'state.txt').open('w') as a,(out/'run.log').open('w') as b:r=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,stdout=a,stderr=b)
 same=''.join((out/'state.txt').read_text().splitlines(True)[:5040]).encode()==(src/f'hip-{arm}/state.txt').read_bytes()
 (out/'exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit':r.returncode,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'body_stream_exact':same}))
 print(arm,r.returncode,same,flush=True)
 assert r.returncode==0 and same

from pathlib import Path
import json,math,hashlib,subprocess,struct
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;out=p/'candidate'
r=json.loads((out/'exit.json').read_text());assert r['exit']==0 and r['body_stream_exact']
initialfile=p.parent/'rain-coupled-cone-point-experiment/hip-initial.txt'
initial={int(t[1]):list(map(float,t[2:15])) for t in map(str.split,initialfile.read_text().splitlines())}
lines=list(map(str.split,(out/'run.log').read_text().splitlines()))
getters={int(t[1]):list(map(float,t[2:])) for t in lines if t and t[0]=='replay-initial'}
pack=lambda x:struct.pack('<'+'f'*len(x),*x)
assert set(initial)==set(getters) and all(pack(initial[k])==pack(getters[k]) for k in initial)
frames={}
for t in map(str.split,(out/'state.txt').read_text().splitlines()):
 frame,key=map(int,t[:2]);x=list(map(float,t[2:]));assert len(x)==14 and all(map(math.isfinite,x));assert key not in frames.setdefault(frame,{})
 frames[frame][key]=x
assert set(frames)==set(range(600)) and all(set(x)==set(initial) for x in frames.values())
limits=[(int(t[1]),int(t[2]),list(map(float,t[3:]))) for t in lines if t and t[0]=='replay-spherical-limit']
assert len(limits)==16200 and len(set((a,b) for a,b,_ in limits))==16200
ids={b for a,b,x in limits if a==0};assert len(ids)==27
assert all(math.isfinite(z) for _,_,x in limits for z in x)
assert all({b for a,b,x in limits if a==f}==ids for f in range(600))
count=0
with (out/'trace.jsonl').open() as src,(out/'excerpt.jsonl').open('w') as dst:
 for line in src:
  d=json.loads(line);count+=1;assert d['frame']==count
  starts=dict(zip(d['body_storage_order'],d['host_state']['step_start_bodies']))
  excerpt={k:d[k] for k in ['frame','bodies','joints','settings']};excerpt.update(schema='rain-cell-diagnostic-excerpt-v1',step_start_bodies=starts)
  dst.write(json.dumps(excerpt)+'\n')
assert count==600
subprocess.run(['python3','scripts/rain-episode-diagnostics/analyze_compliance.py',str(out/'excerpt.jsonl'),'--body-identity','38','--frames','600','--out',str(out/'compliance.json')],check=True)
rows=json.loads((out/'compliance.json').read_text())['rows'];assert len(rows)==600
samples=[]
for x in rows:
 prediction=x['swing_static_softness_residual_estimate'];actual=x['cone_violation_libm'];assert prediction is not None
 samples.append({'frame':x['frame'],'cone':actual,'estimate':prediction,'error':abs(actual-prediction),'speed':max(x['endpoint_angular_speeds']),'axis_alignment':x['start_end_swing_axis_dot'],'sleep':x['endpoint_sleep_flags']})
tail=samples[-120:];stationary=all(x['speed']<1e-3 and x['axis_alignment'] is not None and x['axis_alignment']>1-1e-8 for x in tail)
summary={'scope':'One ordinary600step fresh-history hip replay, not full Rain or five-repeat qualification','integrity':{'initial_exact':True,'first120body_frames_exact':True,'body_rows':25200,'joint_rows':16200,'state_frames':600},'stationary':stationary,'static_compliance_screen_pass':stationary and all(x['error']<1e-4 for x in tail),'tail120':{'peak_cone':max(x['cone'] for x in tail),'peak_estimate_error':max(x['error'] for x in tail),'peak_angular_speed':max(x['speed'] for x in tail),'minimum_axis_alignment':min(x['axis_alignment'] for x in tail),'last':tail[-1]},'trace_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'trace.jsonl').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(p/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
